## Functions

### createShiitakeAcpAgent()

```ts
function createShiitakeAcpAgent(options): AgentApp;
```

Projects ACP stable v1 onto Sessions from one host-authorized directory.

The host directory owns Session creation/loading and authorization. ACP request
IDs are retained for correlation while Shiitake generates its own idempotency
key and returns its own accepted command ID.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                                      |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options` | [`ShiitakeAcpAdapterOptions`](#shiitakeacpadapteroptions) |

#### Returns

`AgentApp`

### createAuthorizedShiitakeSessionDirectory()

```ts
function createAuthorizedShiitakeSessionDirectory(
  options,
): AuthorizedShiitakeSessionDirectory;
```

Adapt one host-authorized Shiitake client factory to ACP Session ownership.
Every create/load gets its own client lease; closing ACP releases that lease
without deleting the durable Session.

| --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
